Subject: Vendor Registration / PO requirements for Redwood

Hi Diego,

We're starting vendor set-up for Redwood in our AP system and need a couple of things to complete the record so your invoices route cleanly to payment. Please confirm and return the attached vendor form. Specifically we need:

- Legal entity name to use on invoices (we have both a US and UK entity on file)
- W-9 or equivalent tax document / EU VAT registration if applicable
- Bank remit instructions (ACH/Wire/SEPA) or a secure way to exchange those details
- Confirmation of how you want POs referenced on invoices (PO number location / required fields)

I've attached our Cobalt vendor form and an example of our PO numbering rules so you can verify acceptance.

We aim to have your vendor record active before the next billing cycle (deadline: Dec 7). Quick answers appreciated.

Thanks,

Hi Marta — thanks for the form and the heads up. We're excited to get this set up. Answers below and I've attached a short PO mapping example that matches the fields you requested.

1) Legal entity for invoices
- Primary: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) — use for invoices to Cobalt US invoices.
- Secondary (for EU invoices if you need local entity): Redwood Inference UK Ltd.

2) Tax documents
- US: W-9 available upon request (we usually send via secure link).
- EU: We are VAT-registered in the UK; we can provide the VAT registration certificate if you need it for your records or to apply reverse-charge accounting.

3) Remit instructions
- Preferred: ACH (US) / SEPA (EU).
- We don't publish bank details over email. We will upload bank remit to the secure portal or send via DocuSign once vendor record is initiated. Please confirm preferred method (secure portal vs DocuSign).

4) PO reference rules
- Required: PO number in the invoice header (top-right) and in the invoice metadata field named "PO_Number".
- Optional but helpful: include the Cobalt cost center and PO line item number in the line-item description.

Attached: redwood_po_mapping_example.xlsx — shows where we expect PO to appear and a sample invoice filename convention: RedwoodInvoice_<InvoiceNumber>_<PO>.pdf

If you need Redwood to supply a default remit-to address (for vendor portal validation) we can provide an interim remit address while the bank details are exchanged.

I'll let Laura (cc'd) add AP-program specifics and compliance notes. Happy to jump on a 20-min call if you prefer to walk through the mapping.

Best,

Hi Marta — quick follow from Redwood AP side with required must-haves to avoid PO hold/failure: 

- Invoice header must exactly match vendor legal name: "Redwood Inference, Inc." (for US invoices). If your system requires a single-line name field, use that exact text.
- PO number must be present on every invoice and match the PO's numeric string (no prefixes) — please confirm whether your system strips leading zeros.
- For EU invoices: provide VAT invoice that includes our VAT number (we will attach when requested). If Cobalt applies reverse charge, please confirm the VAT box on your AP portal so we can mark the invoice accordingly.
- Remit/bank details: Redwood will provide bank wiring instructions via DocuSign link or your secure vendor portal. We prefer DocuSign for first-time exchanges.
- Preferred invoice file types: PDF (searchable) named as Diego suggested; line-items must include SKU or service code if available.

I've attached our internal vendor_onboarding_packet_v1.pdf which includes a checklist to speed the approval.

Thanks for moving this quickly — let us know if Cobalt has an automated vendor API (SFTP/EDIFACT) or only manual portal entry.

Laura Bennett
